plan.objective: Learn useful aim and Bow press/hold/release under autonomous game control; a temporary curriculum toward adaptable all-ability superhuman play.
plan.fallback: If the direct controller does not learn useful shots, fix button timing and learn aim; then remove assistance and train raw aim plus Bow again.
plan.qualification: Scripted baseline must hit this layout before training; stochastic success measured separately from deterministic argmax.
plan.pass_condition: At least 90% hits in 128 stochastic evaluation attempts plus an argmax hit on the fixed setup, then test actual setup variation.
plan.evaluation: Fixed-layout trials measure sampling reliability, not map or position generalization. Reserve separate action RNG seeds for final evaluation.
plan.scope: Do not claim broad strength or integrate a scripted macro into the final agent from this drill.

second_fit.assistance: fixed Bow charging and release, learned aim

third_fit.hypothesis: Learned aim plus a holding-biased initialization lets PPO discover useful charge/release sequences. The policy remains free to release every decision; no fixed duration is used.
third_fit.scope: The assisted stage has a successful argmax shot but has not passed the sampling-reliability gate. This joint-control run must pass that gate without assistance.

fourth_fit.method: Fit the verified scripted Bow sequence at the exact 15 Hz contract, then run unassisted PPO.
fourth_fit.teacher: point relative to opponent plus 4 angle codes; hold 64 ticks when ready, release
fourth_fit.data: one fixed-layout trajectory; a different seed repeats the same trajectory for an explicit replication check, not generalization
fourth_fit.pass_condition: same 90%/128 stochastic plus argmax gate, without any timing script

replication.purpose: Check whether preservation of the seeded shot repeats under independent PPO sampling; same physical task, not independent layouts.

stability_ablation.reason: Success oscillates under PPO; the second seed fell from near-perfect to zero recent hits. Test smaller optimizer steps before adding a new objective or architecture.
stability_ablation.selection: Retain the teacher initialization as the reference; do not choose a checkpoint based on transient training peaks.
